boys.name: Hulk Fist Pen Holder
boys.description: A fun and eye-catching 3D-printed fist-shaped pen holder that adds a playful superhero touch to any study desk. Perfect for holding pens, pencils, markers and other stationery.

girls.name: Ballerina Dance Decorative Showpiece
girls.description: An elegant 3D-printed ballerina decorative showpiece with a flowing layered skirt design. A graceful piece for study tables, bedrooms, shelves, dressing areas and special gifting.
